author: Benjamin Franklin
quotes: Dost thou love life? Then do not squander time, for that’s the stuff life is made of.
Lost time is never found again.

author: Francis Bacon
quotes: Men fear death, as children fear to go in the dark.
It is as natural to die as to be born.

author: Francis Bacon
quotes: Reading maketh a full man; conference a ready man; and writing an exact man.
Some books are to be tasted.

author: Leo Tolstoy
work: Three Questions, in Tolstoi for the Young
quotes: The most important time is now.
The most essential man is the one with whom you happen to be at the moment.

author: Oscar Wilde
work: The Soul of Man under Socialism
quotes: To live is the rarest thing in the world. Most people exist, that is all.
There is no one type for man.

author: Oscar Wilde
quotes: Where there is sorrow there is holy ground.
All the spring may be hidden in the single bud.

author: Kahlil Gibran
quotes: You would measure time the measureless and the immeasurable.
And let today embrace the past with remembrance and the future with longing.

author: John Lubbock
quotes: Time indeed, is a sacred gift, and each day is a little life.
It is wonderful how much innocent happiness we thoughtlessly throw away.

author: William James
work: The Principles of Psychology, Vol. 1, Chapter 11, Attention
quotes: My experience is what I agree to attend to.
Only those items which I notice shape my mind.

author: George Eliot
quotes: Every limit is a beginning as well as an ending.
The growing good of the world is partly dependent on unhistoric acts.

author: Mary Oliver
quotes: Tell me, what is it you plan to do with your one wild and precious life?
Doesn’t everything die at last, and too soon?

author: Emily Dickinson
quotes: Forever is composed of Nows.

author: Emily Dickinson
work: That it will never come again, poem 1741
quotes: That it will never come again is what makes life so sweet.

author: Tim Urban
work: Wait But Why, The Tail End
quotes: Your remaining face time with any person depends largely on where that person falls on your list of life priorities.
Quality time matters.

author: Jane Austen
context: Spoken by Elizabeth Bennet; a fictional character’s advice.
quotes: Think only of the past as its remembrance gives you pleasure.

author: Jane Austen
context: Emma Woodhouse speaking to herself; a fictional character’s reflection.
quotes: There is no charm equal to tenderness of heart.
